new.title: New technical file
new.lead: One technical file per style (PPE Reg. Annex III). Its number comes from your company's series.
new.styleHint: Type to find the style by code or name.
new.needsCertificate: needs the certificate it supports before it is complete
new.existing: This style already has technical file {number}: open that one.
new.noteHint: Optional: anything the keeper should know.
new.suggest: The obvious evidence is linked at once (the style, its released revision, its signed declarations and user information, the certificates that cover it). Nothing is reviewed until a person does.
new.conflict: This style already has a live technical file.

archive.kept: An archived file is kept ten years from today (or until the day you choose), and so are the files it links.
archive.title: Archive {number}
archive.lead: The style is no longer made or sold. The file stays readable and is kept ten years; nothing in it can change.
archive.retainHint: Empty: ten years from today. A later day only.

reopen.title: Reopen {number}
reopen.lead: The file goes back to open: its points can be changed and must be reviewed again before it is complete.

edit.title: Edit {number}
edit.certificateLocked: Only an open file changes its certificate.
edit.certificateHint: A certificate that covers the style.
edit.keeperHint: The person the authority would ask.
edit.retainHint: Now kept until {date}: only a later day.

done.created: Technical file created. Review each point: nothing is reviewed until a person does.

item.linked: Evidence linked to point {letter}: review it next.

done.revision: New revision started from the newest one's hazards.
done.signedReopened: Revision {revision} signed. The file went back to open: point (b) waits for its review.
done.recorded: Test recorded: it is kept ten years with its lab report.
done.recordedFail: Test recorded as failed. The batch shows it.
done.withdrawn: The link of {number} is withdrawn: it opens no more.

sentence.sign: Signing the risk assessment is a legal act: confirm it with a fresh code.
sentence.share: Sending the pack outside the company needs a fresh code.
